body:
{
  "name": "contrarian",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "description": "Devil's advocate for coding agents. Stress-tests plans, architecture and decisions with a steel-man, an assumption audit, a pre-mortem and inversion, then gives severity-rated findings and a verdict.",
  "author": {
    "name": "aaddrick",
    "url": "https://github.com/aaddrick"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/aaddrick/contrarian",
  "repository": "https://github.com/aaddrick/contrarian",
  "license": "Unlicense",
  "keywords": [
    "devils-advocate",
    "pre-mortem",
    "decision-making",
    "architecture-review",
    "risk",
    "codex"
  ],
  "skills": "./skills/",
  "interface": {
    "displayName": "Contrarian",
    "shortDescription": "Devil's advocate that stress-tests a plan before you commit to it.",
    "longDescription": "Stress-test a proposal before reality does. The contrarian steel-mans the plan first, audits its unstated assumptions by likelihood and impact, runs a pre-mortem and inversion, traces second-order effects, and returns severity-rated findings that each carry a failure scenario and a recommendation, then a verdict. Scales its depth to the stakes. Not a code reviewer.",
    "developerName": "aaddrick",
    "category": "Coding",
    "capabilities": [
      "Instructions"
    ],
    "websiteURL": "https://github.com/aaddrick/contrarian",
    "defaultPrompt": [
      "Use contrarian to stress-test this plan before we build it.",
      "Run a pre-mortem on this architecture: assume it failed in six months.",
      "Everyone agrees on this approach. Have contrarian argue the other side."
    ],
    "brandColor": "#B05B33"
  }
}
